pmi632_power.status: Build #33: RTC-backed SOC restore and progress to 98% observed on laptop USB; wall-adapter QC, transient status changes and present capacity remain unverified
pmi632_power.author: Marc Lainez <marc.lainez@gmail.com>
adaptations: Correct STATUS7 temperature bits, input-current sense scaling and QG subtype scaling
Thermistor read failures stop charging; stock hard thresholds and conservative polled JEITA
Read actual charger status instead of inferring charging from supply presence
Stock supplier OCV tables, battery ID selection and Celsius conversion
Select real Android/recovery health HAL; no fabricated battery lifetime metrics
Stock QG 20-second SOC step policy and conditional hold-full adaptation
Read-only b100 NVMEM history: stock signed mAh and eight little-endian cycle buckets; validate magic and capacity bounds
Clear charge inhibit to match Laurel stock's absent inhibit-threshold configuration; pending maintainer validation
Configure floating sources as SDP and DCD timeout to 300 ms to match both 4.14 Laurel boards; pending maintainer validation
Program and verify stock 4/128/100ms QG timing; capture partial FIFO/accumulator and external-sense transitions
Qualified full anchor and recharge latch; remaining-charge CHARGE_COUNTER semantics
Reuse existing AIDL Health supply exclusion via carried hardware/interfaces patch
Bounded QC2/QC3 with legacy QUSB2 DPDM ownership and physical ADC power supervision
Stock-wired SMB1355 I2C/IRQ port with primary-controlled current budgets and fail-safe SMB_EN shutoff
limitations: Latest kernel/DTB/Health/ROM candidate is unbuilt and unvalidated; no 18 W measurement or thermal fault-injection result
Open SOC estimation has no complete downstream ESR/impedance compensation parity
Historical SDAM FCC/cycles are not proof of present usable capacity; learning requires uninterrupted measurements and independent validation
No unique battery pack ID; replacement with same supplier requires state reset
Charging wake source retained while plugged in to protect software thermal polling

soc_continuity_candidate.status: Build #33: SDAM restore and laptop SOC progress observed; broader discharge and full-charge validation pending
